key_insight: MedVTok maps both 2D medical images and 3D volumes from diverse imaging modalities into a shared visual token space, providing a common interface for multimodal medical AI.
problem_solved: Existing medical visual tokenizers are often restricted to particular imaging modalities or dimensions, creating fragmented representations that are difficult to reuse across systems.
method: Introduce a general-purpose visual tokenizer for heterogeneous medical imaging inputs.
Encode 2D images and 3D volumes into a unified token space.
Provide shared visual representations for modeling patient conditions; architectural and training details are not available in the supplied abstract excerpt.
impact: A shared tokenizer could simplify the integration of diverse medical imaging data and improve representation reuse in multimodal AI pipelines. The supplied excerpt does not report quantitative results.
visual_elements: Converging pipeline: diverse 2D images and 3D volumes → MedVTok → unified visual tokens.

paper_title: MedVTok: A General-Purpose Medical Visual Tokenizer
paper_authors: Chenglong Ma, Yuanfeng Ji, Junzhi Ning, Jiyao Liu, Yujie Wei
